map.家电深度清洁周期提醒 使用指南: Deep Cleaning Cycle Reminder for Home Appliances User Guide
map.按家电类型与上次清洁日期排定深度清洁提醒周期，生成待办清单，辅助家庭清洁计划管理: Schedule the deep cleaning reminder cycle by appliance type and last cleaning date, generating a to-do list that helps manage the household cleaning plan.
map.登记空调、洗衣机、油烟机等家电的类型与上次清洁日期，自动算出下次该清洁的时间。: Register appliances such as air conditioners, washing machines and range hoods with their type and last cleaning date, and the next cleaning date is worked out automatically.
map.大扫除前把即将到期的家电一次性列出来，集中安排清洁。: Before a big clean, list the appliances that are about to be due at once and plan the cleaning in one go.
map.养成定期清洁习惯后回填每次实际日期，让提醒周期随实际执行滚动更新。: Once a regular cleaning habit is formed, fill in each actual date so the reminder cycle rolls forward with actual performance.
map.：若空调的清洁周期为 90 天、上次清洁为 6 月 1 日，则下次清洁日期为 8: If the air conditioner's cleaning cycle is 90 days and the last cleaning was 1 June, the next cleaning date is 30 August; the closer the current date gets, the fewer days remaining the page shows, which makes advance planning easier.
map.按类型套用不同周期: Apply a different cycle by type
map.：不同家电的推荐深度清洁周期不同（如滤网类较短、内部管路类较长），页面按所选类型: Different appliances have different recommended deep cleaning cycles (filters shorter, internal pipework longer), and the page applies the cycle matching the chosen type so that not every appliance uses the same frequency.
map.家电清单与清洁记录保存在浏览器本地存储，不会上传；清理浏览器数据后需重新录入。: The appliance list and cleaning records are stored in the browser's local storage and are not uploaded; clearing browser data means entering them again.
map.能提醒多个家电吗？: Can it remind me about several appliances?
map.可以。逐项登记后，页面按各自上次清洁日期与周期分别推算下次清洁日期并列出。: Yes. After each item is registered, the page computes the next cleaning date from its own last cleaning date and cycle and lists them.
map.周期可以自己改吗？: Can I change the cycle myself?
map.周期由所选家电类型决定；若使用环境特殊（如粉尘大），可在记录备注中注明并适当提前: The cycle is set by the chosen appliance type; if the environment is unusual (such as heavy dust), note it in the record remarks and bring the actual cleaning time forward as needed.
